# kgateway v2.5.2 on a kind cluster, as it reached an OpenTelemetry Collector
# (contrib 0.140): each pod's annotated /metrics scraped by the prometheus
# receiver, traces from the ListenerPolicy's OpenTelemetry provider.
# Traffic: 200s, backend 404 and 503, a route to a missing Service (NC),
# a Service with no pods (UH), a closed port (UF), a 1s route timeout (UT),
# an unmatched host (NR), an HTTPRoute regex Envoy rejected (NACK), and the
# controller scaled to zero and back.
#
# metric <process> <name> <type> <label,keys>
# span <name> <http.status_code> <response_flags> <status>
